info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Event Notifications API
info.description: The Manage Event Notifications API enables users to update event subscriptions for specific webhooks within the system. It allows clients to configure which events should trigger notifications, facilitating real-time responses to changes or actions in the application. Typical consumers of this API include developers integrating webhook functionality in their applications, ensuring that their systems react appropriately to relevant events. This enhances user engagement and system interactivity by maintaining accurate and up-to-date notification preferences.
